name: Field Marshal Snowfall
summary: In Ironforge's Military Ward, Field Marshal Snowfall directs the Alliance's preparations against the silithid threat in Silithus. The dwarven officer oversees the supplies gathered for the coming war and rewards those who aid the realm.

sections.title: Quartermaster of the Ahn'Qiraj Effort
sections.body: From Ironforge's Military Ward, Field Marshal Snowfall directs the Alliance's war preparations. He sees the coming conflict as more than a border skirmish. It is a fight against an ancient enemy hostile to all creations of the Titans. Volunteers gather bandages, metal bars, leathers, herbs, and rations in great numbers. Snowfall oversees these stores so Alliance forces can be armed, armored, and fed when the march south to Silithus begins.

sections.title: The Road to Silithus
sections.body: Blacksmiths, gatherers, cooks, and soldiers across Alliance lands all have a part in preparing for war. Snowfall tracks their effort, accepts commendation signets, and offers supply requisitions to volunteers. Once both factions have gathered the required supplies, the stores are packed and hauled south to Cenarion Hold. From there, the grand assault will target the qiraji swarms and the Old God behind the Scarab Wall.

faq.answer: Field Marshal Snowfall is a high-ranking dwarven military officer in Ironforge's Military Ward. He oversees and tallies the Alliance's extensive supplies for the coming war against the qiraji in Silithus.

faq.q: Why is the Alliance collecting so many supplies?
faq.answer: An ancient power threatens Kalimdor from beyond Ahn'Qiraj's gates. Before the armies can march across Silithus's harsh deserts, the Alliance must amass great reserves of armor, metal ingots, medical bandages, food, and herbs.

faq.q: Where do the gathered materials go once finished?
faq.answer: When the Alliance and the Horde have both gathered the required supplies, caravans and supply ships carry the stockpiles to Cenarion Hold in Silithus. There, the combined forces establish their forward staging grounds.

faq.q: What are the Signets for War Supplies used for?
faq.answer: Contributors receive Signets for War Supplies when they donate requested arms and materials. Snowfall accepts the signets in bundles and rewards dutiful Alliance citizens with supply crates and equipment for their service.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you see Snowfall call on every race, from Stormwind to Darnassus, to empty its storehouses for the battle ahead. He represents the Alliance's unified industrial and military will.
As a dwarf, you find Snowfall in the Great Forge's martial district. He speaks with pride of protecting the Titans' creations from an ancient, deep-seated depravity.
